sinks.name: TEE_CreatePersistentObject
sinks.reason: Used to identify/name the persistent object; content is read to determine where/what to create

sinks.name: TEE_CreatePersistentObject
sinks.reason: Controls how much of objectID is read/used; influences identifier parsing and storage lookup

sinks.name: TEE_CreatePersistentObject
sinks.reason: Affects security properties (permissions, overwrite behavior) of the created persistent object

sinks.name: TEE_CreatePersistentObject
sinks.reason: Provides object attributes/metadata that may be read and stored with the persistent object

sinks.name: TEE_CreatePersistentObject
sinks.reason: Data buffer whose content is written into secure persistent storage as the object's initial contents

sinks.name: TEE_CreatePersistentObject
sinks.reason: Controls how much data from initialData is written to persistent storage

sinks.name: TEE_MemMove
sinks.reason: receives copied bytes; can write sensitive data into memory

sinks.name: TEE_MemMove
sinks.reason: provides bytes to copy; reads potentially sensitive data from memory

sinks.name: TEE_MemMove
sinks.reason: controls amount of data moved; affects how much is read/written and potential overflows

sinks.name: TEE_OpenPersistentObject
sinks.reason: Buffer content is used to locate/select a persistent object; attacker-controlled ID can influence secure storage access.

sinks.name: TEE_OpenPersistentObject
sinks.reason: Controls how much of the identifier buffer is read; impacts parsing/bounds and object selection.

sinks.name: TEE_OpenPersistentObject
sinks.reason: Receives a handle to the opened persistent object, enabling subsequent reads/writes of sensitive data.

sinks.name: TEE_ReadObjectData
sinks.reason: identifies the persistent/transient object from which data will be read

sinks.name: TEE_ReadObjectData
sinks.reason: receives object data bytes read from secure storage/object

sinks.name: TEE_ReadObjectData
sinks.reason: controls how many bytes are read into the output buffer, affecting data exposure and bounds

sinks.name: TEE_ReadObjectData
sinks.reason: returns actual number of bytes read, reflecting data transfer amount

sinks.name: TEE_SeekObjectData
sinks.reason: determines which object's data is being accessed/positioned for subsequent reads/writes
sinks.role: object handle (selects which persistent/transient object data stream to seek within)

sinks.name: TEE_SeekObjectData
sinks.reason: controls where in the object's data stream subsequent operations will read/write, affecting access to sensitive data regions

sinks.name: TEE_SeekObjectData
sinks.reason: influences how the offset is applied (e.g., from start/current/end), impacting which data is targeted

sinks.name: TEE_WriteObjectData
sinks.reason: contains the bytes that will be written/stored; potential sink for sensitive/tainted data
sinks.role: input data buffer to be written to a persistent object

sinks.name: TEE_WriteObjectData
sinks.reason: controls how many bytes are written from the provided buffer
sinks.role: size of the input data buffer

sinks.name: strlen
sinks.reason: reads memory content byte-by-byte until a NUL terminator is found, potentially exposing or depending on sensitive data and risking over-read if not properly terminated
